title: Seeking Visions
description: Come and sit again. One reading proves nothing, and a faith built on a single vision is built on a guess. What the sand shows this week is not owed to you.

objectives.description: Meditate at the Temple of Three Gods

notes: This is a system, not a plot - no invented threat attached. Giver motive: the priest asks for repetition because one vision is an anecdote and a dozen are a pattern, which is how his doctrine treats evidence generally. Voice only; the 7-day cooldown is the mechanical shape and needs no story reason beyond it.
